site.name: Tabimarket
site.description: Full-day tours across Japan, from operators we read before they list. Choose a date, choose how many are going, pay by card.

hero.eyebrow: Mount Fuji · Asagiri Tours · full day
hero.headline: The lakes are still
hero.sub: Full-day tours across Japan, from operators we read before they list. Pick a date, say how many are going, pay by card.

places.label: Places
places.heading: Six places, one day each
places.sub: Every tour here runs a full day, on the dates its operator set.

tours.label: Live now
tours.heading: Approved and bookable
tours.sub: Each one has been read by a person here before it went up.

steps.title: An operator writes the day
steps.body: Price, the dates they can run it, what is included, and at least four photographs. Fewer than four and the form will not submit.

steps.title: We read it
steps.body: Someone here opens the listing, checks the photographs are of that day, and approves it or sends it back with the reason.

steps.title: You book it
steps.body: Only approved tours are shown. You pick a date the operator set, say how many are going, and pay by card.

supplier.label: For operators
supplier.heading: Sell your days here
supplier.body: Write the tour once, set your own dates and price, upload your photographs. We read it, then it is live and bookable.

tours.title: Tours across Japan
tours.description: Every approved full-day tour on Tabimarket, by place, with its price and the dates its operator set.
tours.label: Catalogue
tours.heading: Every approved tour
tours.sub: Full days only. Prices are per traveller.
tours.empty: No tour here yet for that place.

tour.title: Tour
tour.description: A full-day tour on Tabimarket: what the day is, what is included, the dates the operator set, and the price per traveller.
tour.missing: That tour is not here. See every tour.

gallery.title: Photographs
gallery.description: Photographs from the tours listed on Tabimarket, as their operators uploaded them.
gallery.label: Photographs
gallery.heading: The days, as they look
gallery.sub: Every picture here came from the operator who runs that day.

book.title: Choose a date
book.description: Pick a date the operator set and say how many are going.
book.label: Booking
book.heading: Choose a date
book.note: Capacity per date and the cancellation terms are waiting on the owner.
book.signin: Sign in to book this day.

checkout.title: Pay

checkout.label: Payment
checkout.heading: Pay for the day
checkout.name: Name on the card
checkout.note: Nothing is charged here — this is the design.

booking.title: Booking confirmed
booking.description: Your tour is booked and paid.
booking.label: Confirmed
booking.heading: You are booked
booking.sub: The operator has your booking and will write to you with the meeting point the week before.

account.title: Your account

account.label: Account
account.heading: Your bookings

signin.heading: Sign in
